name: Shopify Dev
description: Shopify's developer server searches shopify.dev and introspects the Admin and Storefront GraphQL schemas, so generated queries match the real API. It needs Node.js.

probe.note: Invocation from the vendor's documentation, pinned to @shopify/dev-mcp@1.18.0, the newest stable release published on 2026-11-11. The catalog never starts it unpinned.
